sentences.target: Hello! My name is Alex.
Hi there, I am a new fifth grade student.
Nice to meet you, my friend.
How are you doing today?
I am doing great, thank you.
How is your day going so far?

sentences.target: It is a yellow wooden pencil.
Is this your new school bag?
What color is your new bicycle?
My bicycle is bright blue.
I like red and pink flowers.

It is sunny and warm outside.
Take an umbrella because it is raining.

sentences.translation: 그녀는 자전거를 아주 잘 탈 수 있어.

sentences.translation: 그는 피아노를 멋지게 칠 수 있어.

sentences.translation: 나는 강에서 낚시하는 것을 좋아하지 않아.

sentences.target: Where is my favorite wristwatch?

sentences.target: Where did I put my pencil case?
Look inside your school backpack.
They are on top of the study table.
Your books are inside the desk drawer.
